input: Send thank-you cards after the holiday dinner

gold.taskTitle: Send Thank-You Cards After Holiday Dinner
gold.taskDescription: Send thank-you cards to guests or hosts following a holiday dinner event.

questions.title: Who are you sending the thank-you cards to?
questions.description: Identify the recipients: dinner guests, the host, gift-givers, or a combination.

questions.title: How many people need to receive a card?
questions.description: Determine the total number of cards needed to plan quantity and effort.

questions.title: What is the deadline for sending the cards?
questions.description: Establish the target send date, such as within a week of the dinner or by a specific date.

questions.title: Will the cards be physical, handwritten, or digital?
questions.description: Clarify the format: mailed paper cards, store-bought cards, or e-cards sent online.

questions.title: Do you already have cards, or do you need to buy them?
questions.description: Determine whether purchasing or sourcing cards is a required step in the plan.

questions.title: Should each card have a personalised, unique message?
questions.description: Clarify whether messages are tailored per recipient or based on a shared template.

questions.title: Do you have current mailing addresses for all recipients?
questions.description: Identify whether collecting contact or address information is a step that needs to be completed first.
